Layout groups by affinity inside a shared region: a chain with one
consumer stays together, values sharing one downstream consumer group
despite having no edges among themselves, the widely used database
glues nothing together, and route registrations keep their order.

package shared

import (
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/httpserver"
)

//fabrik:cli:command
func Sync(ctx cli.Context, r *Report, o *Orders, server *httpserver.Server) error { return nil }

//fabrik:cli:command
func Check(ctx cli.Context, r *Report, o *Orders, server *httpserver.Server) error { return nil }
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/httpserver"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/shared"
)

func run() int {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	sigc := make(chan os.Signal, 2)
	signal.Notify(sigc, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer signal.Stop(sigc)
	go func() {
		<-sigc
		cancel()
		<-sigc
		os.Exit(1)
	}()

	root := &cli.Command{
		Name: "app",
		Subcommands: []*cli.Command{
			{
				Name: "sync",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					sharedReport, sharedOrders, err := buildDb()
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					server, err := buildServer()
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					return shared.Sync(ctx, sharedReport, sharedOrders, server)
				},
			},
			{
				Name: "check",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					sharedReport, sharedOrders, err := buildDb()
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					server, err := buildServer()
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					return shared.Check(ctx, sharedReport, sharedOrders, server)
				},
			},
		},
	}
	return root.Exec(os.Args[1:], cli.WithSignalContext(ctx))
}

func buildDb() (*shared.Report, *shared.Orders, error) {
	sharedDBDb, err := shared.NewDB()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}

	sharedAudit := shared.NewAudit(sharedDBDb)
	sharedLedger := shared.NewLedger(sharedDBDb)
	sharedSources := shared.NewSources()
	sharedDialect := shared.NewDialect()
	sharedUsers := shared.NewUsers(sharedDBDb)
	sharedReport, err := shared.NewReport(sharedSources, sharedDialect, sharedUsers, sharedLedger, sharedAudit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}

	sharedOrders := shared.NewOrders(sharedDBDb)

	return sharedReport, sharedOrders, nil
}

func buildServer() (*httpserver.Server, error) {
	// Providers
	r := router.New()

	// Register
	r.Handle("/reports", shared.Reports())
	r.Handle("/orders", shared.OrderList())
	r.Handle("/audit", shared.AuditLog())

	return httpserver.New(r, nil), nil
}
